# ProPublica

> > ProPublica is an independent nonprofit newsroom dedicated to investigative journalism and accountability reporting in the public interest.

ProPublica combines deep investigative reporting across national and regional hubs with interactive data tools and public records databases. The organization covers critical topics including government accountability, criminal justice, health care, racial justice, and campaign finance through both traditional journalism and innovative news applications.

## Key Topics

- investigative journalism
- government accountability
- campaign finance
- criminal justice
- election integrity
- racial justice
- health care
- immigration enforcement
- nonprofit accountability
- public records
- regional reporting
- dark money
- police accountability
- wrongful convictions
- accountability reporting

## Main News & Investigations

- [ProPublica Homepage](https://www.propublica.org): ProPublica homepage featuring investigative journalism and breaking news.
- [Investigative Reporting on Politics](https://www.propublica.org/topics/politics): Political reporting on campaign finance, dark money, and elections.
- [Investigative Reporting on Criminal Justice](https://www.propublica.org/topics/criminal-justice): Criminal justice reporting on police accountability and wrongful convictions.
- [Investigative Reporting on Health Care](https://www.propublica.org/topics/health-care): Health care investigative journalism on medical reporting and policy.
- [Investigative Reporting on Racial Justice](https://www.propublica.org/topics/racial-justice): Investigative reporting on racial justice, housing discrimination, and equity.

## Regional Reporting Hubs

- [Local Initiatives](https://www.propublica.org/local-initiatives): ProPublica's local newsroom initiatives and regional reporting hubs.
- [Local Reporting Network](https://www.propublica.org/local-reporting-network): Local Reporting Network collaborative journalism partnerships and initiatives.
- [Midwest](https://www.propublica.org/midwest): Midwest regional investigative reporting hub covering Wisconsin and region.
- [South](https://www.propublica.org/south): Southern regional hub covering reproductive rights and healthcare access.
- [Southwest](https://www.propublica.org/southwest): Southwest regional reporting on immigration and election integrity.
- [Texas](https://www.propublica.org/texas): Texas news hub with Texas Tribune partnership covering immigration enforcement.
- [Northwest](https://www.propublica.org/northwest): Northwest regional reporting from Idaho and Washington states.

## Data Tools & Interactive Projects

- [News App Archives](https://www.propublica.org/newsapps): Interactive news apps with data visualization and public records.
- [Nonprofit Explorer](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits): Nonprofit Explorer database with IRS tax filings and executive compensation data.

## Multimedia & Community

- [Video](https://www.propublica.org/video): ProPublica video content including documentaries and explainers.
- [Email Newsletters](https://www.propublica.org/newsletters): ProPublica email newsletter subscriptions and community engagement.

## About & Support

- [About Us](https://www.propublica.org/about): About ProPublica nonprofit newsroom mission and organizational overview.
- [Donate to ProPublica](https://give.propublica.org/campaign/748664/donate): 501(c)3 nonprofit donation page for ProPublica membership.
